decisions.meaning_summary: Microscopy measurement record preserves specimen boundary, visible scale and existing focus plane; specimen contact is a guard retaining only contacts already specified for that measurement.

corrections.before: microscopy measurement capture with scale and sample contact
corrections.after: a microscopy measurement record preserving the specimen boundary, visible scale and focus plane, with only the specimen contacts already specified for that measurement retained
corrections.reason: Resolve mandatory but endpoint-unspecified sample contact into a preservation guard: only specimen contacts already specified for this measurement are retained; this neither selects a new contact endpoint nor adds a scientific result.

rejected_boundaries: Retain object and microscopy/sample intrinsic guards. Contact preservation is conditional on an already specified measurement contact, not a new positive contact fact or framing requirement. No invented sample-stage/slide endpoint, scientist, efficacy, numeric calibration or result. The existing focus plane is retained without choosing its geometric position.
